newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian 175-day T-bill yields 35.00 pct. [CORRECTED 00:30 GMT 20/03]
newsitem.headline: Russian 175-day T-bill yields 35.00 pct. [CORRECTED 00:30 GMT 20/03]

text.p: The annualised average yield on an issue of 175-day GKO discount Treasury bills was 35.00 percent at an auction on Wednesday, the Central Bank said.
Dealers had forecast the yield would be in the 32.0-35.0 percent range.
The series 22060 bills, maturing on September 17, 1997, the closest maturity date to the new issue, closed at 87.12 on Tuesday, to yield 29.49 percent.
The series 22060 bills are not subject to a recent 15 percent tax unlike the new issue.
Full details of the auction follow:
(Corrects lowest and highest accepted prices to conform with revised information from the central bank.)

On March 19 the Finance Ministry has repaid about 6.63 trillion roubles in maturing six-month T-bills (series 22045). It has also raised 4.83 trillion roubles in 301-day T-bills making total proceeds from today's auctions 7.56 trillion roubles.
